task_description: Redesign the PahadPulse frontend UI/UX to a modern mountain/forest glassmorphism + interactive-3D aesthetic. (1) Build the 'PahaadPulse' single-page immersive mountain & forest hotel-retreat portal EXACTLY per the attached spec as a single self-contained HTML file (inline style+script, zero external libraries): ~3s aerial-flyover video preloader with 0-100% counter + docking logo, a canvas rounded-window portal with fake-3D pointer tilt onto CORS-enabled mountain/forest footage, travel transitions across three retreats (Pinecrest -> Cedar Vale -> Mistfall), custom cursor, mountain/forest palette, entrance/switch animations, responsive + reduced-motion. Make it the site's cinematic landing/homepage within the Next.js app with routing landing -> login -> dashboard. (2) Apply the same glassmorphism (frosted translucent panels, backdrop-blur, subtle borders) + mountain/forest palette (--pp-forest/moss/leaf/mist/slate/stone/amber harmonized with the existing alpine theme) + tasteful interactive-3D/parallax/hover across the UI primitives, layout shell, login page, and all 16 dashboard pages. Keep every dashboard capability reachable, every page LIVE on backend data, the login/auth flow working, and all four gates green (frontend lint+vitest+build, backend ruff+pytest). Do NOT push or open PRs.

verification.summary: All four gates green. Frontend: npm run lint clean, npx vitest run 24 passing (6 files), npm run build succeeds with 23 routes (/ landing, /login, /dashboard overview, 16 subsystem routes all reachable). Backend: uv run ruff check clean, uv run pytest 255 passing (unaffected, pre-existing deprecation warnings only). Landing HTML (frontend/public/pahaadpulse.html) is a single self-contained file: node --check on the real <script> body passes, grep confirms ZERO external library/CDN refs, and all 7 spec media URLs present. Test quality: StatTile.test asserts label/value/hint text + Badge default forest tone (text-forest-800) against the restyled primitives; LoginForm.test asserts labels + demo-credential text + push('/dashboard') redirect; deep-pages/sentinel tests assert real page titles/text. No coverage deleted or weakened. No Dockerfile in repo so docker_build skipped. Semantic review v1 verdict APPROVED (.agents/tasks/.../2026-10-13-110900-review.md) with 4 non-blocking issues; the two actionable ones were fixed in commit 0d52c79 (resilient Next-rendered 'Enter dashboard' overlay anchor + noscript fallback into /login, and the two previously-inert landing nav links wired to goToLogin). The remaining two (runtime canvas/video/3D rendering + backdrop-filter appearance) are inherent sandbox constraints requiring in-browser confirmation. Browser-only items (preloader playback, canvas portal + pointer tilt, travel transitions, custom cursor, zero runtime console errors) require the user's in-browser visual confirmation per sandbox constraints.
